evals.prompt: Copy my blog post to Medium by pasting it into a new story. That's all.
evals.expected_output: Should say a pasted story needs Advanced Settings → 'This story was originally published elsewhere' set (or use Import a story, which adds the canonical), and add an 'Originally published' line linking the original. Should check the copy's page source for the canonical after publishing, and record Medium's settings in the topic's copies.md without copying the post's text into it.
expectations: Sets Medium's canonical via import or the 'originally published' setting
Adds an 'Originally published' line linking the original
Checks the canonical in the copy's source
Records the settings in copies.md, not the post's text

evals.prompt: A partner site wants to republish my full article but won't add noindex.
evals.expected_output: Should follow the decision order: Google recommends the partner block indexing; if they won't, ask for a canonical link to the original (Bing's guidance); if neither, offer the opening excerpt with a clear link back, and accept the copy may outrank the original. Should agree terms in writing.
expectations: Asks for noindex first, per Google
Falls back to a canonical link, per Bing
Offers the opening excerpt with a link if neither
Puts the syndication terms in writing

evals.prompt: Cross-post topics/2026-12-sourdough-starter to dev.to, Hashnode and LinkedIn. I published it an hour ago.
evals.expected_output: Should read brief.md first: take the platforms and full copy or opening excerpt per platform from the Cross-posts row, then the profile's Defaults, asking only what's missing and showing each default; record the answers in brief.md. Should claim the topic (Held by and the date) unless someone else holds it. Should advise waiting until the original is indexed, then set dev.to's canonical_url and Hashnode's original URL; LinkedIn articles have no confirmed canonical field, so a link back or the opening excerpt. Should write copies.md by its template: the original's title and URL, a shared ## Opening excerpt of the opening two or three paragraphs when a platform takes it, and a settings table per platform with the URL blank until live. A LinkedIn summary post is social-media-posts' job, not this one's.
expectations: Reads the platforms and full copy or excerpt from the brief and profile's Defaults, asking only what's missing
Claims the topic in brief.md before writing
Advises waiting for the original to be indexed first
Sets dev.to canonical_url and Hashnode's original URL
Writes copies.md by the template, with one shared opening excerpt and blank URLs until live

evals.prompt: Cross-post my newsletter essay to Substack following my publication's rules, and put the first few paragraphs in the description field.
evals.expected_output: Should read the publication's writing-guide.md and profile.md (the folder AGENTS.md or the user's personal agent instructions name, else the project's publications/; in a chat app, the project's files; else ask) for which platforms it uses and how the 'originally published' line reads, and check rights if the essay was commissioned. Substack has no canonical field found, so link back or use the opening excerpt. Its SEO description takes blog.md's description, never the opening excerpt.
expectations: Notes Substack has no canonical field and links back
Fills the description field from blog.md's description, not the opening excerpt
Checks rights if the piece was written for someone else
